name: James Burton
bio: A bookmaker, known in the ring as 'Watson', with whom Fred Atkins lived at Osnaburgh Street, Tachbrook Street and elsewhere between about 1891 and 1894, and with whom he worked blackmail. The Rochester Row incident of June 1891 - a gentleman found in bed with Atkins, the charge afterwards dropped - belonged to that partnership, and the charge-sheet from it was the perjury trap that destroyed Atkins's credibility as a Crown witness in April 1895.

context_engagements.period: Osnaburgh Street, Tachbrook Street and elsewhere, 1891-1894
